requirements.description: Crisp outlined sprites, shared pixel density, readable human/building scale and compact rich town/forest composition with varied roofs, tall grass and original identities.
Continuous paving and natural grass regions without repeated diamond stamping or mirrored motifs.
Coherent stream banks and interlocking grass/paving margins, readable bridge approaches and continuous material joins.
Correct visible idle and whole-body walking cycles in NE SE SW NW, stable feet and identity at wraps; input direction matches pose.
Flow follows joined stream, fountain spray animates around fixed masonry; full cycles wrap coherently and pause freezes motion.
Three original creatures have readable idle and greeting responses, no fragments or root drift.
Click and held input explore meadow, town, forest and far bank; bridge crosses both ways and water/bridge sides block entry; focus loss releases motion.
Approach and greet three creatures with observable response and clear progress; pause and restart behave coherently.
Record browser/renderer, median/p95 frame interval and blank baseline at desktop/mobile; assess smooth exploration.
